description: Return the contents of one free file so the geometry can be read or modified directly: STEP and DXF as UTF-8 text, STL as base64. Units are millimetres, true size. Use it after get_free_files gives the file name and the content itself is needed; use get_free_files when a download URL is enough, which is cheaper for large files. Files over 600 KB are not inlined: the response carries inlined=false, size_bytes and the URL to fetch instead. An unknown file name is an error that lists the valid names. Read-only, no auth, no charge.

file.description: A file name exactly as get_free_files lists it, e.g. '4080-100'.

format.description: Default step. DXF exists only for 2D sections such as extrusion profiles.

object.description: Object slug as returned by find_geometry or find_by_dimensions, e.g. '4080-aluminum-extrusion'. An exact object name or alias also resolves; anything else is an error with a hint to search first.

name: get_file_content

content.description: The file contents, present when inlined is true.

encoding.description: utf-8 for STEP and DXF, base64 for STL.

inlined.description: False when the file was too large to include; fetch url instead.

url.description: Direct download URL for the same file.

title: Read one CAD file's contents
